title: FirstService Residential Expands Pennsylvania Portfolio, Welcomes Remington Oaks Condominium Association
body_markdown:
# FirstService Residential Expands Pennsylvania Portfolio, Welcomes Remington Oaks Condominium Association


Tuesday November 10, 2026


FirstService Residential, North America's leading residential community management company, is proud to announce its selection as the new full-service property management partner for Remington Oaks Condominium Association in Chalfont, Pennsylvania.


Nestled in the heart of historic Bucks County, Remington Oaks offers residents the charm of suburban living with convenient access to major employment centers, shopping, dining, and transportation corridors. The sought-after community is known for its attractive setting and appeal to families, professionals, and commuters alike.


"We are thrilled to welcome Remington Oaks to the FirstService Residential family," said Michael Mendillo, President, East Region, FirstService Residential. "From day one, our team has been focused on building strong relationships with the board and delivering the expertise, resources, and support needed to help the community thrive. We are excited to partner with the board as they continue to enhance and strengthen this exceptional community."


The association's board sought a management partner with a proven track record, deep operational expertise, and access to extensive resources that could support both its current needs and long-term objectives.


"Remington Oaks was looking for more than a management company. They wanted a strategic partner with the experience and capabilities to help guide the community's future," said Donna Fiore, Senior Vice President, C/HOA, FirstService Residential. "We look forward to leveraging the full strength of our organization, from innovative technology and financial expertise to trusted guidance and local market knowledge, to help the board achieve its goals and elevate the resident experience."


As the leader in residential community management, FirstService Residential partners with boards, owners, and residents to enhance property values, improve community operations, and create exceptional living experiences. Backed by local expertise, industry-leading resources, and a commitment to service excellence, the company delivers tailored solutions that help communities succeed today while building lasting value for the future.


**About FirstService Residential**


FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.


Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community’s specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.


Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.


FirstService Residential is a subsidiary of FirstService Corporation (NASDAQ and TSX: FSV), a North American leader in providing essential property services to a wide range of residential and commercial clients.


Nov 10, 2026
